figurative_meaning_en: A preliminary or tentative account that is not final
example_sentences_in_bangla: এখনও কাঁচা হিসাব, চূড়ান্ত হবে পরে।
ব্যবসার লাভ-ক্ষতির কাঁচা হিসাব করে দেখা গেছে ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: This is still a rough account; the final one will come later.
The preliminary calculation of business profits and losses looks good.
note: Commonly used in colloquial and professional Bengali contexts for non-final assessments.
